company.name: Selfdrive.ae
company.shortDescription: SelfDrive.ae is a Smart Mobility Transportation Network Company.
company.description: SelfDrive.ae is a Smart Mobility Transportation Network Company,  Selfdrive is one of the fastest growing all technology platform that seamlessly integrates car manufactures and dealer network with Subscription based tech for on demand monthly rentals and Lease to Own business models in the region. It offers On Demand Car Ownership experience with Zero Liabilities. SelfDrive.ae brings in industry leading expertise in car rentals, leasing and e-commerce. It’s the reagions 1st platform to offer 1 day to 36-month leasing and Car Subscription rentals in the region, Serving B2B, B2C and B2G customers. It has served more the 6000+ clients from 90 different nationalities and has received over 200K+ confirmed days of reservation on its platform. Selfdrive.ae partners with Car manufacturers, Dealer Networks and Leasing companies to offer a complete range of cars starting from economy, Mid Size Saloons, Compact SUVs, MUVs and 4x4 SUVs to serve its customers. Selfdrive.ae platform currently operates a fleet of 600 cars on road and intents to reach 1000 cars by end of 2019. The company also has plans to add 3000 cars exclusively on the Micro lease platform making it one of the fastest growing  car subscription Company in the region with plans to expand its services across GCC.
